If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.$B$BThat's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.$B$BYou've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall.  Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.

c9db6538a7db7e9ac193856248d5ff77a4cd5ab7.RewardText: Excellent! Now just a few adjustments and this thing will be as good as new. Oh yes, your key! Here you go.$B$BBy the way, the Jump-a-tron still has a few kinks that I need to work out. Um, just be careful.

c9e12fa30c2042eccb00f532bde8085ad3ae89f9.RewardText: Zanzil the Outcast??$b$bIf Yenniku is held by that troll, a vile and powerful witchdoctor, then I fear that only a faint hope remains. Faint. And tiny as the smallest insect.$b$bBut still, it is hope.

c9e1c58a543860e90fd946faacedec0e629bc85f.LogDescription: Magistrix Seyla at the Throne of Kil'jaeden wants you to kill 4 Emaciated Felbloods by using the Fel Siphon on them.  You will need Demonic Blood from nearby Wrath Heralds to power the Fel Siphon.
c9e1c58a543860e90fd946faacedec0e629bc85f.QuestDescription: When Kael's forces retreated through that portal, his most loyal lackeys were rewarded with an abominable gift.  They  stayed behind and gorged themselves on the blood of demons for days.$B$BThe blood has changed them, given them new powers.  It will also prove their undoing.$B$BObtain blood samples from other demons.  Use them to power this fel siphon and deprive these arrogant fools of their new powers.  Slay them in their weakened state and return to me.

c9e319321b421044e0a29e614978c87a13ab7ab7.LogDescription: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered.  She claimed that it was where her horse was.  As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.
c9e319321b421044e0a29e614978c87a13ab7ab7.QuestDescription: "The package must be delivered... delivered before I'm trapped here!"$B$BThe cries of a panicked woman feel almost like a whisper floating through the house.  Cowered in the upstairs corner is the apparition of a woman.  She does not seem to be fully cognizant of her surroundings, and she is only vaguely aware of you.$B$B"Are you here to deliver my package?  Please, before it gets much worse!  I was going to ride out of here.  It should still be by my horse... or am I too late?"

c9e46b4315587ab662b12710d0aaed2da4c83d6a.Text: Maginor says that twisting alternating flows of positive energy actually creates a much more stable flow.

c9e9fa6e9565644740ecc0b97305358fd9cefd37.LogDescription: Donny at Ivald's Ruin in the Howling Fjord wants you to kill 10 Iron Rune Destroyers, 5 Iron Rune Laborers and 2 Iron Rune Sages.
c9e9fa6e9565644740ecc0b97305358fd9cefd37.QuestDescription: Keep it down, $r. These iron dwarves are quick on the trigger. Now don't let the activities down in the dig fool you. Those steel-skinned abominations aren't digging anything up! No sir - on the contrary - they're burying the site! For whatever whacked out reason, they don't want anyone finding this place.$B$BWhat kind of dwarf buries ancient relics and dig sites? I'll tell you what kind: the kind you kill with reckless abandon! Get in there and take 'em out!

c9ea23b57958c612f439f807c9518c1504a1a988.RewardText: Your spirit burns with life, young $c. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

texts.text0_0: A mess, that's what this is!  All of these creatures sprung up out of nowhere, and are running around out of control!  And where've the Magister, and his apprentices, run off to?  Leaving me here all alone without as much as a, "Hello there Wyllithen, would you like to come with?"$B$BThe nerve!

c9f3140842bfa11f940c408325c6983cd9480d95.Text: You will not stop the Frost Lord from entering this world, mortal. The Tidehunter's might will crush that of Ragnaros once and for all, leaving your land a frozen paradise!

c9f4217acc1cf1fb2047a7ff16324ddbbcde7249.Text: So then the array of magics would cascade into a chain reaction of positively charged energies.
